About me

Profile

My career started on a KFC shift floor in Bangladesh, where I learned that a supply chain is judged at the counter. From there I moved into purchasing, then into supply chain and procurement management for denim and garment exporters, a buying office and an industrial manufacturer, buying machinery, spare parts and production materials and negotiating the contracts behind them.

In 2025 I moved to New Zealand for postgraduate study and completed a Master of Business Management in Supply Chain Management at the University of Waikato. Alongside study I ran inventory control for a Hamilton retailer: replenishment, cycle counts, special orders and seasonal stock across roughly 6,000 lines.

I'm looking for coordinator, planner, analyst or category roles where hands on stock work and procurement experience both count.

Hamilton, NZ
BC

Inventory Controller

Blaze N Chill (Naughty Brothers Ltd)
About the company

An independent Hamilton retailer trading as Blaze N Chill under Naughty Brothers Ltd, carrying a wide range of around 6,000 product lines with walk in and special order customers.

Responsibilities

  • Own stock replenishment across about 6,000 SKUs, setting reorder quantities from sales history in Lightspeed.
  • Run scheduled cycle counts, investigate variances and correct stock records so the system matches the shelf.
  • Raise purchase orders, receive deliveries and check them against invoices and packing slips.
  • Plan promotional and seasonal stock so popular lines are in place before demand peaks.
  • Manage customer special orders from request to pickup and keep merchandise displays full and tidy.
  • Flag slow moving and aged stock early so it can be cleared before it becomes a write off.

Highlight

Reduced inventory write offs by around $160,000.

  6. Obtaining and Selecting Offers
